representation: IEEE-754 binary64 bit pattern stored in MSL ulong; all arithmetic in integer operations
implemented: classification: sign, zero, finite, infinity, NaN, signaling NaN
binary64 multiply using exact 106-bit integer product
binary64 fused multiply-add using exact product, 128-bit alignment/cancellation, and one RN-even packing
binary64 divide using restoring quotient generation and sticky remainder
ordered equality and relational comparisons; unordered NaN results
exact signed int32 and unsigned uint32 numeric widening to binary64
round-to-nearest-even unsigned uint64 numeric widening to binary64
finite in-range binary64 to int32 conversions with RN-even and toward-zero modes
finite in-range nonnegative binary64 to uint32 conversion toward zero
signed zero and gradual underflow/overflow handling
correctly rounded binary64 square root using integer radicand and RN-even packing
unimplemented: remainder, modulo, nextafter, scalbn, frexp, signed-int64 numeric widening, and binary64-to-uint64 conversion
transcendental functions including log, log2, exp, exp2, and pow
directed rounding modes and IEEE exception flags
NaN totalOrder and signaling exception behavior
nan_policy: Arithmetic quiets and returns the first NaN operand, preserving sign and payload bits; invalid non-NaN operations return canonical positive quiet NaN. No exception flags are tracked.
integer_conversion_policy: int32/uint32 widening is exact; uint64 widening rounds RN-even. soft64_rint_bits returns a binary64 integral value with ties-to-even. soft64_to_i32_rn/rz and soft64_to_u32_rz return {valid:false,value:0} for NaN, infinity, or values outside their defined destination ranges; callers must not rely on CUDA out-of-range conversion sentinels.

source_interfaces.cuda_fma_rn_binary64: soft64_fma(ulong,ulong,ulong) -> ulong; integer-only binary64 fused multiply-add with one RN-even result, signed zeros, and gradual underflow
source_interfaces.cuda_int2double_rn: soft64_from_i32(int) -> ulong; exact for every int32 input
source_interfaces.cuda_uint2double_rn: soft64_from_u32(uint) -> ulong; exact for every uint32 input
source_interfaces.cuda_double2int_rz: soft64_to_i32_rz(ulong) -> Soft64I32Result; valid only when finite and the truncated value is in int32 range
source_interfaces.rint_binary64: soft64_rint_bits(ulong) -> ulong; RN-even, integral binary64 encoding
source_interfaces.subnormal_float_mantissa_cast: soft64_to_u32_rz(ulong) -> Soft64U32Result; finite nonnegative uint32-range domain
source_interfaces.binary64_longlong_bitcasts: soft64_from_i64_bits(long), soft64_to_i64_bits(ulong), and identity word representation; bit reinterpretation only

verification: MetalToolchain 27.1 compiled and executed temporary probes on the installed Apple GPU. A deterministic 256-lane boundary/pseudo-random finite probe emitted 5,888 words; bounded comparisons returned zero mismatches. A separate 59-lane edge probe made 1,121 oracle comparisons with zero mismatches, including signed zero, qNaN/sNaN payload quieting, invalid-operation NaNs, int32/uint32 conversion boundaries, and binary64-to-binary32 rounding ties. This remains bounded evidence; it does not exhaust all IEEE input space or consumer-specific CUDA behavior, so the contract status remains implemented-unverified. The later soft64_fma addition has not been compiled or executed and is not covered by those comparisons.
